verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents REST endpoints in prose pages (faults, projects, notices, deploys) and publishes an llms.txt docs index, but neither is a machine-readable API spec. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the candidate paths. Prose API docs and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a downloadable OpenAPI-equivalent spec, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
